The schedule from my earlier answer stands. The team note is wrong, because Cara can't be in slot 4.

If Cara were in slot 4, Ann, Hana and Ivo would have to fill slots 1 to 3. Ann and Ivo must be exactly two slots apart, and Ann must come before Hana.
- Ann 1, Hana 2, Ivo 3 puts Gus in slot 5, only 2 slots from Ivo. Gus and Ivo must be at least 3 apart, so this fails.
- Ivo 1, Ann 3 leaves no slot for Hana between Ann and Cara, so this fails.

Cara = 5 works. That gives Gus = 6 and Finn = 8, since Finn must be exactly 2 from Gus and at least 3 from Cara. Elif is then 9 and Dev is 7. Ann = 1 and Ben = 4 follow from Ben being at least 3 slots after Ann. Ivo = 3 is two slots from Ann, which leaves Hana = 2.

I checked all 16 constraints against this schedule and every one holds.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Hana","3":"Ivo","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Gus","7":"Dev","8":"Finn","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
